QuestInfo.name: Resistance Support for Lv. 80 Explorers.
QuestInfo.0: #bCassandra#k is giving out gifts to Explorers who've reached Lv. 80. Go see her once you reach Lv. 80.
QuestInfo.2: You received an item that will help your new colleague in the Resistance.

0.0: I, Cassandra, am giving a special gift to MapleStory adventurers who have reached Level 80. Will you accept the gift?

yes.0: Come see me, Cassandra, at any of the nearest towns. I'll be waiting!

no.0: The gift event will be going on until December 19, so please come see me anytime.

1.0: This is a special bonus EXP item exclusive to the #rBattle Mage, Wild Hunter#k of the #rResistance#k that will be revealed on #bDecember 20#k. This item will help you gain EXP. You cannot use it yet because it is exclusive to the Resistance, but after #bDecember 20#k, you can use it once you have created a Resistance member. Oh, and remember to check the expiration date!
